'''Michael Hochman''' ({{Langx|he|מיכאל הוכמן}}) is an Israeli [[mathematician]], currently a professor at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]]. He is known for his contributions to [[dynamical systems]] and [[ergodic theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mike Hochman |url=http://www.ma.huji.ac.il/~mhochman/ |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=www.ma.huji.ac.il}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Michael Hochman - Author Profile - zbMATH Open |url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=Michael+Hochman |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=zbmath.org}}</ref> 

Hochman earned his PhD from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] under supervision of [[Benjamin Weiss]] in 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Michael Hochman - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=134962 |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> He published his scientific work in such journals as ''[[Annals of Mathematics]]'', ''[[Inventiones Mathematicae]]'', and ''[[Journal of the European Mathematical Society]]''.<ref name=":0" />

Hochman was an invited speaker at [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]] in 2018,<ref>{{Cite web |title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers {{!}} International Mathematical Union (IMU) |url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers?combine=Hochman |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=www.mathunion.org}}</ref> and at the conference {{ill|Dynamics, Equations and Applications|pl|Dynamics, Equations and Applications (DEA 2019)}} in [[Kraków]] in 2019.<ref>[https://www.dea.agh.edu.pl/invitedspeakers DEA 2019 Invited Speakers]</ref>

In 2015, he received the [[Erdős Prize]] from the [[Israel Mathematical Union]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Erdős Prize |url=https://www.imu.org.il/erdos-prize |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=IMU |language=en}}</ref> In 2018, Hochman was also awarded the [[Michael Brin Prize in Dynamical Systems]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Michael Brin Prize in Dynamical Systems {{!}} Eberly College of Science |url=https://science.psu.edu/math/research/dynsys/brinprize |access-date=2023-03-05 |website=science.psu.edu}}</ref>
